title: Invoices and Receipts: Pay Links, Branding, Numbers and Refund Notices | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
An invoice tells a customer what they owe and gives them a link to pay it; a receipt proves a payment arrived. The CrestApps Transactions and Receipts features give every invoice a number (INV-1001) and a pay link that works without signing in for 60 days, send a numbered receipt (R-1001) after every payment, send refund notices, and print cleanly with your business's name, logo, address and footer.

In this video:
• Why invoices and receipts, and how numbers, links and notices fit together
• Branding invoices and receipts
• Sending an invoice, and printing it or copying its pay link
• The customer paying from the link, with no account
• Recording a payment and the numbered receipt
• Refund notices, the test payment badge and the Base url
• Use cases
